editorial:
Imagine living in a tiny Sicilian town where everyone is used to cutting corners and ignoring the rules. That is exactly the world you enter here. You get to follow a new mayor who is actually honest and decides to do everything by the book. The problem is that the locals have spent years doing things the wrong way, and they aren't too happy about this sudden change. It creates a funny and chaotic vibe because you see the clash between one man's dream of a fair city and a community that just wants to keep things easy and messy.

The acting is great, especially since the leads know how to make the comedy land without trying too hard. The pacing keeps you interested, though some parts feel a bit slow since it is a character study. If you enjoy stories about the underdog fighting a stubborn system, you will love this. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see the beautiful Italian scenery. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for a rainy day movie night.
endingExplained: In the end, the mayor realizes that being perfectly honest is almost impossible when everyone around him is cheating. He does not give up, but he learns to be more flexible to actually get things done. The townspeople eventually gain a new respect for him because he stayed true to his heart. It wraps up with a warm feeling, showing that while you cannot change everyone overnight, a little bit of honesty can still make a big difference.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves light comedies about small towns and quirky characters.
